0022600090.text: The New Orleans Pelicans open their 2026-27 season at home against the Indiana Pacers, who also have not played a game this season. The teams split their two meetings in 2025-26, and the most recent one was a 127-119 Pacers win in Indiana on January 16, 2026. Indiana is without Johnny Furphy, who is out after knee surgery, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pelicans a 35% chance to win.
